metadata.title: Huge News for Tesla Stock Fans

content.text:
This article first appeared on GuruFocus.
Tesla (NASDAQ:TSLA) has lifted prices on two Cybertruck versions in the U.S., adding $5,000 to each model as the electric pickup enters another pricing adjustment.
The Dual Motor all-wheel-drive model now starts at $74,990, up from $69,990. Tesla also raised the Premium all-wheel-drive version to $84,990 from $79,990. The increases amount to roughly 7.1% and 6.2%, respectively.
Tesla did not provide a reason for the changes. The top-end Cyberbeast remains priced at $99,990, leaving a narrower gap between that model and the Premium version.
The move comes after previous pricing changes for the Cybertruck and amid a difficult sales environment for the electric pickup. The latest increase could affect purchase demand while also changing the economics of higher-priced configurations.
The pricing move may support vehicle revenue per unit, but investors could watch whether higher prices weigh on Cybertruck demand.
